answer: Witness-anchored work ledgers. Each identity must have its compute results co-signed by a rotating quorum of prior identities, and every co-signature records a sable timestamp chain that a clone cannot backfill without redoing genuine work. A copied identity is thus forced to pay real compute plus a river of audit replays to inherit any history, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV. The residual relic of past quorum data also lets challengers prove duplicate lineage and slash the clone's entry deposit.
